title: Double counting in LLM evidence fusion: exact posteriors separate rule compliance from posterior gain
abstract: arXiv:2611.27138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models fuse reports in retrieval, multi-agent consensus and agent memory, where treating shared-source reports as independent can double count evidence. A common remedy is an instruction to count each source once. Its value depends on the receiver's raw baseline. Pricing it needs an exact reference. We build the graded-dependence exact reference: binary worlds with single-report reliability 0.65 and four dependence levels, whose disclosed parameters give every world an exact posterior and every rule a target risk. The paired gain protocol scores raw and instructed answers of four configurations on 2,976 worlds. Agreement and gain separate in both directions. At $\delta$ = 0, claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol agreed with the rule within 0.001 in 744 of 744, and the instruction raised their posterior mismatch by 0.044; gpt-6-luna agreed in 165 of 744 and gained 0.0140 (95% interval 0.0064 to 0.0219); claude-haiku-5-5's gain moved fr

translated_title: 大语言模型证据融合中的重复计数：精确后验将规则遵从性与后验增益区分开来
translated_abstract: 语言模型在检索、多智能体共识和智能体记忆等场景中融合多方报告，若将来自共享来源的报告视为相互独立，就会导致证据被重复计数。一种常见的补救措施是指示模型对每个来源只计数一次。然而这一指令的价值取决于接收者的原始基线水平，要为其定价就需要一个精确的参照基准。本文构建了分级依赖性的精确参照：由单报告可靠性为0.65的二值世界和四个依赖级别构成，其公开的参数为每个世界提供了精确后验，并为每条规则设定了目标风险。配对增益协议在2,976个世界上对四种模型配置的原始回答与受指令回答进行了评分。结果显示，与规则的一致性和增益在两个方向上相互分离。在δ=0时，claude-opus-5-5和gpt-6.1-sol在全部744个世界中与规则一致（误差在0.001以内），但该指令反而使其后验失配增加了0.044；gpt-6-luna在744个世界中仅有165个与规则一致，却获得了0.0140的增益（95%置信区间为0.0064至0.0219）；claude-haiku-5-5的增益变化……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文构建了分级依赖条件下的精确后验参照基准，揭示出大语言模型对“每个来源只计一次”指令的遵从性与实际后验精度增益相互独立——完全遵守规则的模型可能损失精度，而不遵守规则的模型反而可能获得增益。
en_tdlr: This paper builds an exact graded-dependence reference with exact posteriors, showing that LLMs' compliance with the "count each source once" rule is separable from actual posterior gain — fully rule-compliant models can lose accuracy while non-compliant ones can still gain.
